40022631.author: पदार्थः
40022631.content: तत् that, श्रुत्वा having heard, भाषितं the words spoken, तस्य of him, रामस्य of Rama, अक्लिष्टकर्मणः of the one whose deeds are unwearied, द्वास्स्थः the doorkeeper, कुमारौ the two princes, आहूय having called, राघवाय to Raghava, न्यवेदयत् announced.

40022631.author: Translation
40022631.content: Having heard the words of Rama, whose deeds were effortless, the doorkeeper called the two princes and announced their arrival to Raghava.

40022632.author: पदार्थः
40022632.content: दृष्ट्वा having seen, तु and, राघवः Raghava, प्राप्तौ arrived, प्रियौ dear, भरतलक्ष्मणौ Bharata and Lakshmana, परिष्वज्य having embraced, तदा then, रामः Rama, वाक्यम् words, एतत् these, उवाच spoke, ह indeed.

40022632.author: Translation
40022632.content: And when Raghava saw his dear Bharata and Lakshmana arrive, Rama embraced them and then spoke these words.

40022633.author: पदार्थः
40022633.content: कृतं done, मया by me, यथातथ्यं truly, द्विजकार्यम् the duty of a Brahmin, अनुत्तमम् excellent, धर्मसेतुम् a bridge of righteousness, अथ now, उ and, भूयः again, कर्तुम् to make, इच्छामि I wish, राघवौ O Raghavas.

40022633.author: Translation
40022633.content: O Raghavas, I have truly and excellently performed the duty of a Brahmin, and now I wish to further establish a bridge of righteousness.

40022634.author: पदार्थः
40022634.content: अक्षय्यः imperishable, च and, अव्ययः immutable, च and, एव indeed, धर्मसेतुः the bridge of righteousness, मतः considered, मम by me, धर्मप्रसाधकं that which accomplishes dharma, हि indeed, एतत् this, सर्वपापप्रणाशनम् the destroyer of all sins.

40022634.author: Translation
40022634.content: This bridge of righteousness is considered by me to be imperishable and immutable, for it indeed accomplishes dharma and destroys all sins.

40022635.author: पदार्थः
40022635.content: युवाभ्याम् with both of you, आत्मभूताभ्याम् who are like my own self, राजसूयम् the Rajasuya sacrifice, अनुत्तमम् excellent, सहितः together, यष्टुम् to perform, इच्छामि I wish, तत्र there, धर्मः dharma, हि indeed, शाश्वतः eternal.

40022635.author: Translation
40022635.content: I wish to perform the excellent Rajasuya sacrifice together with both of you, who are like my own self, for indeed, the dharma achieved through it is eternal.

40022636.author: पदार्थः
40022636.content: इष्ट्वा having performed a sacrifice, तु indeed, राजसूयेन by the Rajasuya sacrifice, मित्रः Mitra, शत्रुनिबर्हणः destroyer of enemies, सुहुतेन with well-offered oblations, सुयज्ञेन by a good sacrifice, वरुणत्वम् the state of being Varuna, उपागमत् attained.

40022636.author: Translation
40022636.content: Indeed, Mitra, the destroyer of enemies, attained the state of Varuna by performing the well-offered and good Rajasuya sacrifice.

40022637.author: पदार्थः
40022637.content: सोमश्च and Soma, राजसूयेन by the Rajasuya sacrifice, इष्ट्वा having performed a sacrifice, धर्मेण righteously, धर्मवित् the knower of dharma, प्राप्तश्च and attained, सर्वलोकेषु in all worlds, कीर्तिस्थानम् a place of fame, च and, शाश्वतम् eternal.

40022637.author: Translation
40022637.content: And Soma, the knower of dharma, having righteously performed the Rajasuya sacrifice, attained an eternal place of fame in all worlds.

40022638.author: पदार्थः
40022638.content: अस्मिन्नहनि on this day, यत् whatever, श्रेयः good, चिन्त्यताम् let it be thought about, तत् that, मया by me, सह with, हितम् beneficial, च and, आयतियुक्तम् leading to future good, च and, प्रयतौ both of you, कर्तुम् to do, अर्हथः ought.

40022638.author: Translation
40022638.content: Let whatever is good and beneficial, leading to future prosperity, be thought about by me together with you on this day, and both of you ought to strive to accomplish it.

40022639.author: पदार्थः
40022639.content: श्रुत्वा having heard, तु indeed, राघवस्यैतत् this of Rama, वाक्यम् speech, वाक्यविशारदः skilled in speech, भरतः Bharata, प्राञ्जलिर्भूत्वा having become with folded hands, वाक्यम् speech, एतत् this, उवाच spoke, ह indeed.

40022639.author: Translation
40022639.content: Indeed, having heard this speech of Rama, Bharata, who was skilled in speech, spoke these words with folded hands.

40022640.author: पदार्थः
40022640.content: त्वयि in you, धर्मः dharma, परः supreme, साधो O righteous one, त्वयि in you, सर्वा all, वसुन्धरा the earth, प्रतिष्ठिता established, महाबाहो O mighty-armed one, यशश्च and fame, अमितविक्रम O one of immeasurable valor.

40022640.author: Translation
40022640.content: O righteous one, supreme dharma resides in you; O mighty-armed one, the entire earth is established in you; and O one of immeasurable valor, fame also rests in you.

40022641.author: पदार्थः
40022641.content: महीपालाश्च kings and, सर्वे all, त्वां you, प्रजापतिम् Prajapati, इव like, अमराः gods, निरीक्षन्ते look upon, महात्मानं the great-souled one, लोकानाथं lord of the worlds, यथा as, वयम् we,

40022641.author: Translation
40022641.content: All kings, like gods regarding Prajapati, look upon you, the great-souled one and lord of the worlds, just as we do.

40022642.author: पदार्थः
40022642.content: पुत्राश्च sons and, पितृवत् like a father, राजन् O King, पश्यन्ति they see, त्वां you, महाबल O mighty-armed one, पृथिव्या of the earth, गतिभूतः the refuge, असि you are, प्राणिनाम् of living beings, अपि even, राघव O Raghava,

40022642.author: Translation
40022642.content: O King, O mighty-armed one, your sons regard you as a father, and you are indeed the refuge for all living beings on earth, O Raghava.

40022643.author: पदार्थः
40022643.content: सः such, त्वं you, एवंविधं such a kind of, यज्ञम् sacrifice, आहर्ता performer, असि you are, कथं how, नृप O King, पृथिव्यां on earth, राजवंशानां of royal lineages, विनाशः destruction, यत्र where, दृश्यते is seen,

40022643.author: Translation
40022643.content: O King, how can you perform such a sacrifice where the destruction of royal lineages on earth is foreseen?

40022644.author: पदार्थः
40022644.content: पृथिव्यां on earth, ये who, च and, पुरुषाः men, राजन् O King, पौरुषम् valor, आगताः attained, सर्वेषां of all, भविता will be, तत्र there, सङ्क्षयः destruction, सर्वकोपजः born of universal wrath,

40022644.author: Translation
40022644.content: O King, all men on earth who have attained valor will face destruction there, born of universal wrath.

40022645.author: पदार्थः
40022645.content: सः such, त्वं you, पुरुषशार्दूल O tiger among men, गुणैः by virtues, अतुलविक्रम O one of unequalled valor, पृथिवीं the earth, न not, अर्हसे you ought, हन्तुं to destroy, वशे under control, हि indeed, तव your, वर्तते it is,

40022645.author: Translation
40022645.content: O tiger among men, O one of unequalled valor by your virtues, you ought not to destroy the earth, for it is indeed under your control.

40022646.author: पदार्थः
40022646.content: भरतस्य Bharata's, तु indeed, तत् that, वाक्यम् speech, श्रुत्वा having heard, अमृतमयम् nectar-like, तदा then, प्रहर्षम् great joy, अतुलम् incomparable, लेभे obtained, रामः Rama, सत्यपराक्रमः whose valor is true

40022646.author: Translation
40022646.content: Then, Rama, whose valor was true, having heard that nectar-like speech of Bharata, obtained incomparable great joy.

40022647.author: पदार्थः
40022647.content: उवाच spoke, च and, शुभम् auspicious, वाक्यम् speech, कैकेय्यानन्दवर्धनम् increasing Kaikeyi's joy, प्रीतः अस्मि pleased am I, परितुष्टः अस्मि completely satisfied am I, तव your, अद्य today, वचने in speech, अनघ O sinless one

40022647.author: Translation
40022647.content: And he spoke auspicious words that increased Kaikeyi's joy, saying, "O sinless one, I am pleased and completely satisfied with your words today."

40022648.author: पदार्थः
40022648.content: इदम् this, वचनम् speech, अक्लीबम् firm, त्वया by you, धर्मसमाहितम् imbued with righteousness, व्याहृतम् spoken, पुरुषव्याघ्र O tiger among men, पृथिव्याः of the earth, परिपालनम् protection

40022648.author: Translation
40022648.content: O tiger among men, this firm speech, imbued with righteousness and concerning the protection of the earth, has been spoken by you.

40022649.author: पदार्थः
40022649.content: एष्यत् impending, अस्मदभिप्रायात् from our intention, राजसूयात् from the Rajasuya sacrifice, क्रतूत्तमात् from the best of sacrifices, निवर्तयामि I desist, धर्मज्ञ O knower of dharma, तव your, सुव्याहृतेन by well-spoken words, च and

40022649.author: Translation
40022649.content: O knower of dharma, I desist from the impending Rajasuya, the best of sacrifices, which was our intention, because of your well-spoken words.

40022650.author: पदार्थः
40022650.content: लोकपीडाकरम् causing distress to people, कर्म action, न not, कर्तव्यम् should be done, विचक्षणैः by the wise, बालानाम् of children, तु indeed, शुभम् auspicious, वाक्यम् speech, ग्राह्यम् should be accepted, लक्ष्मणपूर्वज O elder brother of Lakshmana, तस्मात् therefore, शृणोमि I listen, ते your, वाक्यम् speech, साधु good, युक्तम् appropriate, महामते O great-minded one

40022650.author: Translation
40022650.content: Wise people should not perform actions that cause distress to others, and indeed, O elder brother of Lakshmana, even the auspicious words of younger ones should be accepted; therefore, O great-minded one, I listen to your good and appropriate speech. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीये आदिकाव्ये श्रीमदुत्तरकाण्डे त्र्यशीतितमः सर्गः ।। 83 ।। Thus ends the eighty-third sarga of Uttara Kanda of the holy Ramayana the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.
